name: Stanley SCH121S1H-B1 12V Li-Ion Cordless Drill & 100-Pc Tool Kit
shortDescription: Comprehensive maintenance combo kit featuring a 12V Li-Ion cordless hammer drill (26 Nm torque), battery charger, and 100-piece hand tool and fastener set.
overview: The Stanley SCH121S1H-B1 combo kit is the ultimate turnkey solution for facility maintenance engineers, site technicians, and field installers. At its core is a compact, high-torque 12V Max lithium-ion cordless hammer drill driver delivering 26 Nm of peak torque with a 20-stage adjustable clutch, 2-speed planetary metal gearbox, and hammer mode for drilling masonry. Packed alongside the drill is an extensive 100-piece hand tool collection—including a drop-forged claw hammer, combination pliers, utility snap knife, magnetic bit driver, level, screwdrivers, drill bits, and wall plugs—all housed in an organized blow-molded case.
keyFeatures: 12V Max cordless hammer drill with 2-speed metal gearbox (0-400 / 0-1500 RPM)
20-position torque clutch with hammer drilling mode delivering up to 26 Nm torque
10mm keyless single-sleeve chuck with automatic spindle lock for fast bit swaps
Integrated bright LED work light illuminates dark work areas in electrical cupboards
Includes 100 essential hand tools and fasteners for complete on-site repair readiness
High-capacity 1.5Ah Lithium-Ion battery pack with electronic cell protection
Rugged heavy-duty blow-molded carrying case with molded compartments for every tool

specifications.Drilling Capacity: Wood: 20 mm, Steel: 10 mm, Masonry: 8 mm
